declarations.name: generated_complete
declarations.source_header:
theorem generated_complete (bits depth : Nat)
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (inventory : Inventory) (before : Checked (bits + 2)) (good : Good before)
    (current : At formulas solver inventory before)
    (semantic : SemanticReady before.native.machine.heap)
    (context : Context Plain inventory.source before.native.machine)
    (stored : Joint Plain inventory.source before.native) (origins : Origins inventory.source before.native)
    (scopedCache : SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeScopeCache.Scoped before.native)
    (idle : SourceRecursiveIntersectionNative.Idle before.native)
    (left right : Value Symbol Guard)
    (leftAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = [])
    (leftCap : SourceCurrentConstrainedCap.Cap Plain depth left)
    (rightCap : SourceCurrentConstrainedCap.Cap Plain depth right)
    (nodes : before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next < 2 ^ bits)
    (edges : before.native.machine.heap.edges.next ≤ 2 ^ (bits + 2))
    (room : before.native.machine.domains.next +
      2 ^ (before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next + before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next * before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next) <
      2 ^ (bits + 1)) :
    let next := SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeInventoryRebase.extend inventory before.native.machine.heap good.native.machine.1
      current.growth current.history left right leftAvailable rightAvailable leftClosed rightClosed
    ∃ fuel value after, Receipt next depth formulas solver fuel left right before value after := by

declarations.name: generated_complete
declarations.source_header:
theorem generated_complete [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (state : Checked width) (good : Good state)
    (contextual : SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeContextCache.Contextual oldView
      (finiteInputMeaning oldView oldInputs) (finiteRankedInput oldView oldInputs) holds state.native)
    (covered : Covered oldInputs state.native)
    (scopedCache : SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeScopeCache.Scoped state.native)
    (semantic : SemanticReady state.native.machine.heap) (idle : SourceRecursiveIntersectionNative.Idle state.native)
    (growth : Grows source state.native.machine.heap)
    (history : Extends source.nodes.issued state.native.machine.heap.nodes.issued)
    (left right : Value Symbol Guard)
    (leftAvailable : Available state.native.machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available state.native.machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = [])
    (ranges : WordRanges (.code (requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain left right)) state) :
    let target := state.native.machine.heap
    let targetRoots := roots ++ [left, right]
    ∃ targetAvailable : Values target targetRoots,
      ∃ targetClosed : ∀ root ∈ targetRoots, root.free = [],
        ∃ fuel value after, Receipt target formulas solver
          (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeInputInventoryModels.finiteInput target good.native.machine.1 holds targetRoots
            (SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeGrownInventory.closed_originals target good.native.machine.1
              targetRoots targetAvailable targetClosed) targetAvailable targetClosed)
          fuel left right state value after := by

declarations.name: rebase
declarations.source_header:
theorem rebase
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (inventory : Inventory) (before : Checked width)
    (good : SourceCurrentAllocatedNativePhysicalCompletion.Good before) (current : At formulas solver inventory before)
    (left right : Value Symbol Guard)
    (leftAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = []) :
    let next := extend inventory before.native.machine.heap good.native.machine.1 current.growth current.history
      left right leftAvailable rightAvailable leftClosed rightClosed
    At formulas solver next before ∧
      next.source = before.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = inventory.roots ++ [left, right] ∧
      (next.inputs (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver)).valid (inputOf left) ∧
      (next.inputs (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver)).valid (inputOf right) := by

declarations.name: rebase
declarations.source_header:
theorem rebase (agreement : Agreement before after) (holds : SourceGuard → Term SourceSymbol → Bool)
    (state : SourceRecursiveIntersectionThunks.State width SourceSymbol SourceGuard)
    (admitted : Admitted oldView (finiteInputMeaning oldView before) state) (seen : SeenAdmitted before state)
    (valid : Contextual oldView (finiteInputMeaning oldView before) (finiteRankedInput oldView before) holds state) :
    Contextual newView (finiteInputMeaning newView after) (finiteRankedInput newView after) holds state ∧
      Admitted newView (finiteInputMeaning newView after) state ∧ SeenAdmitted after state :=

theorem cold_complete (bits depth : Nat)
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (machine : Machine Symbol Guard) (operations : SourceEqualityConstraintMemoAllocation.State)
    (good : Good (⟨initial (bits + 2) machine, operations⟩ : Checked (bits + 2)))
    (semantic : SemanticReady machine.heap)
    (guards : SourceCurrentConstrainedCapGuardHeap.Heap Plain machine.heap)
    (left right : Value Symbol Guard) (leftOriginal : Original left) (rightOriginal : Original right)
    (leftAvailable : Available machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = [])
    (leftCap : SourceCurrentConstrainedCap.Cap Plain depth left)
    (rightCap : SourceCurrentConstrainedCap.Cap Plain depth right)
    (nodes : machine.heap.nodes.next < 2 ^ bits) (edges : machine.heap.edges.next ≤ 2 ^ (bits + 2))
    (room : machine.domains.next + 2 ^ (machine.heap.nodes.next + machine.heap.nodes.next * machine.heap.nodes.next) <
      2 ^ (bits + 1)) :
    let inventory := SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeInventoryCold.pairInventory machine.heap good.native.machine.1
      left right leftOriginal rightOriginal leftAvailable rightAvailable leftClosed rightClosed
    ∃ fuel value after,
      SourceCurrentConstrainedCapCheckedJointInventoryQuery.Receipt inventory depth formulas solver fuel left right
        ⟨initial (bits + 2) machine, operations⟩ value after := by

declarations.name: complete_many
declarations.source_header:
theorem complete_many (depth : Nat) (reserved : Resources bits source (domains source) initial)
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (requests : List (Value Symbol Guard × Value Symbol Guard))
    (inputs : ∀ pair ∈ requests, Available source pair.1 ∧ Available source pair.2 ∧
      pair.1.free = [] ∧ pair.2.free = [] ∧ Cap Plain depth pair.1 ∧ Cap Plain depth pair.2)
    (inventory : Inventory) (before : Checked (bits + 2))
    (ready : Ready before) (admitted : At formulas solver inventory before)
    (current : Current source (domains source) initial before) (native : Native before)
    (memos : Memos) (valid : Valid before.native.machine.heap memos) :
    ∃ results after next,
      Queries formulas solver memos requests before results after ∧ Ready after ∧ At formulas solver next after ∧
      Extension before.native.machine after.native.machine ∧ Current source (domains source) initial after ∧
      Native after ∧ Values after.native.machine.heap results ∧ (∀ result ∈ results, Cap Plain depth result) ∧
      (∀ result ∈ results, result.free = []) ∧ Valid after.native.machine.heap memos ∧
      after.native.machine.domains.next ≤ initial.next + (domains source).length := by

        before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next * before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next) < 2 ^ (bits + 1)) :

      SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeDomainTrace.Prefixes

credit_mono

declarations.source_header:
theorem prefix_bound {control next : Control A} {before after : Checked width}
    (actual : Trace fuel control before next after) (good : Good before) (fields : Fields control before)
    (stored : Stored bound before.native.machine.heap)
    (certificate : ControlAt control before bound post) :
    SourceCurrentAllocatedRecursiveMassTrace.InputsThrough fuel bound control before ∧
      ControlAt next after (massAfter fuel bound) post ∧ Good after ∧ Fields next after ∧
      Stored (massAfter fuel bound) after.native.machine.heap ∧
      after.native.machine.heap.nodes.next ≤ before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next + credit fuel bound ∧
      after.native.machine.heap.edges.next ≤ before.native.machine.heap.edges.next + credit fuel bound ∧
      after.native.machine.domains.next ≤ before.native.machine.domains.next + fuel := by

declarations.name: initial
declarations.source_header:
theorem initial (bits : Nat) (holds : Guard → Language.Term Symbol → Bool) (before : Checked (bits + 2))
    (good : Good before) (semantic : SourceEqualityRequiredSemanticCache.SemanticReady before.native.machine.heap)
    (idle : SourceRecursiveIntersectionNative.Idle before.native)
    (left right : Value Symbol Guard) (leftOriginal : Original left) (rightOriginal : Original right)
    (leftAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = [])
    (stored : Stored mass before.native.machine.heap)
    (nodes : before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next < 2 ^ bits)
    (edges : before.native.machine.heap.edges.next ≤ 2 ^ (bits + 2))
    (room : before.native.machine.domains.next +
      2 ^ (before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next + before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next * before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next) < 2 ^ (bits + 1)) :
    let request : NodeRequest Symbol Guard := ⟨IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain, left, right⟩
    let bound := instructionBound before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next before.native.machine.heap.edges.next mass
    ∃ fuel value after,
      Receipt fuel (.code (requestNode request.domain request.left request.right)) before value after
        (fun final result => Available final.heap result) ∧
      SourceRecursiveIntersectionNative.Idle after.native ∧ fuel ≤ bound ∧
      execute (bound + 1) (.code (requestNode request.domain request.left request.right)) before = .done value after ∧
      Stored (massAfter bound mass) after.native.machine.heap ∧ InternedValueMass.value value ≤ massAfter bound mass ∧
      after.native.machine.heap.nodes.next ≤ before.native.machine.heap.nodes.next + credit bound mass ∧
      after.native.machine.heap.edges.next ≤ before.native.machine.heap.edges.next + credit bound mass ∧
      after.native.machine.domains.next ≤ before.native.machine.domains.next + bound := by

theorem node_prefix (source : InternedConstructorTemplates.State Symbol Guard) (facts : InternedNestedFacts.Facts source)
    (holds : Guard → Language.Term Symbol → Bool) (request : NodeRequest Symbol Guard) (scope : NodeScope source request)
    (complete : Completes (view source holds) (SourceRecursiveIntersectionNative.nodeSemantic request))
    {next : Control (Value Symbol Guard)} {before after : Checked width}
    (actual : Trace fuel (.code (requestNode request.domain request.left request.right)) before next after)
    (good : Good before) (ready : NodeReady before.native.machine request)
    (sourceGrowth : Grows source before.native.machine.heap)
    (sourceHistory : Extends source.nodes.issued before.native.machine.heap.nodes.issued) :
    fuel ≤ nodeBudget source holds request := by

declarations.name: Step.verified
declarations.source_header:
theorem Step.verified [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula)
    (inventory : Inventory) {left right value : Value Symbol Guard} {before after : Checked width}
    (actual : Step left right before value after)
    (ready : Ready before) (admitted : At formulas solver inventory before)
    (leftAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap left) (rightAvailable : Available before.native.machine.heap right)
    (leftClosed : left.free = []) (rightClosed : right.free = [])
    (ranges : WordRanges (.code (requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain left right)) before)
    (memos : Memos) (valid : Valid before.native.machine.heap memos) :
    ∃ next : Inventory,
      next.source = before.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = inventory.roots ++ [left, right] ∧
      Receipt formulas solver next left right before value after memos := by
